## Why This Course Matters

In this course, you build a foundation for understanding how food moves from farms to consumers, how prices form, and how the parts of the supply chain connect. We work with real-world data to see how value is added across the food system, measure market concentration, and explore the role of forecasting and risk management tools like futures and options.

These skills help you analyze market conditions, interpret trends, and connect day-to-day business decisions with broader patterns in food and agricultural markets.

### Our Learning Culture

I want you to imagine we’re all part of the same organization—one where everyone’s success depends on how well we collaborate, share ideas, and support each other’s growth. That means:

- We take initiative and hold ourselves accountable.
- We celebrate experimentation and embrace failure as part of the process.
- We give and receive feedback with curiosity and respect.
- We build a culture that reflects the kind of teams we’d want to work on in the real world.

My goal is to help you **connect what you're learning to real decisions and real contexts**. By the end of the course, you’ll have experience working with market data, applying economic concepts to real marketing problems, and communicating your analysis in ways that support sound decision-making.
